# `parallax.viewmodel`

`from parallax.viewmodel import ...` · source: `sdk/parallax/viewmodel.pyi`

First-person viewmodel (`plugins.viewmodel()`): arms and a held item drawn over the world
with their own field of view and near plane (they never clip into walls), moved by
procedural layers instead of baked clips, because what they do answers what the player
does this frame:

```text
base     hip pose, eased to the aim pose by `aim()` (solved from the item's "sight"
         socket, so any optic centres itself), and to the sprint pose while running
bob      a figure-eight paced by the body's ground speed (stance and aim damp it)
sway     smooth noise that never visibly repeats
lag      the item trails the camera's turning on a spring, overshoots, settles
recoil   `fire()` kicks a spring-damper with the item's learnable per-shot pattern
land     a dip when the body lands
poses    named keyframed moves on top (draw, holster, reload, inspect, throw, swing)
```

The hands are put on the item's grip sockets by the arms' Animator IK (`reach`), every
frame, so any item with "grip_r" / "grip_l" sockets is held correctly without posing.

Arms. Without an `arms` prefab the viewmodel draws the engine's procedural arms: sleeved
upper arms, bare forearms and hands with fingers curled for a grip, skinned to a
shoulder / elbow / wrist rig whose elbows bend (IK) to reach the grips. Recolor them with
`skin_color` and `sleeve_color`; give `arms` a prefab (an Animator with left_hand /
right_hand limbs, e.g. a copy of the library's `fp_arms` piece to restyle) to use your own,
or set `procedural_arms` False for none (a floating item).

Put a Viewmodel on an entity parented to the first-person camera (a camera prefab child):

```text
{"components": {"camera": {"rig": "first_person", "fov": 75, "offset": [0, 1.6, 0]}},
 "children": [{"name": "hands", "components": {"viewmodel": {
     "item": "carbine_view", "arms": "fp_arms", "fov": 54}}}]}
```

Weapon code drives it with methods (acting on one entity is a method of its component):

```text
vm = ctx.camera.main.entity.child("hands").get(Viewmodel)
vm.fire()                  # on each shot
vm.aim(ctx.input.held(Controls.zoom))
vm.play("reload")          # its cues ("mag_out"…) arrive as ViewmodelCue
vm.item = Prefabs.pistol_view   # swapping plays "draw"
```

Camera space: +x right, +y up, +z forward, meters; turns are degrees (pitch, yaw, roll) with
the engine's pitch convention: pitch + tips the muzzle UP, yaw + turns it right (as Camera
pitch, `Camera.kick` and `Recoil.pitch`; unlike a Transform's Euler x, which is + down).
Everything is game state: saved, rewound and replayed with the entity.

### `Recoil`

```python
@record
class Recoil
```

How a shot moves the item (handling, not ballistics).

**Fields**

- `kick_back: float = field(0.02, min=0, unit='m')`
- `kick_up: float = field(0.007, min=0, unit='m')`
- `pitch: float = field(3, unit='deg', doc='Muzzle rise per shot (positive up).')`
- `yaw: float = field(0.8, min=0, unit='deg', doc='Sideways wander per shot (a fixed pattern, not random).')`
- `roll: float = field(1.8, min=0, unit='deg')`
- `frequency: float = field(9, min=0.1, unit='Hz', doc='How fast it springs back.')`
- `damping: float = field(0.42, min=0, doc='1: no overshoot; lower rings.')`
- `pattern: list[float] = field([1.45, 1.3, 1.15, 1.05, 1.0], doc='Per-shot strength; the last repeats.')`
- `reset: float = field(0.3, min=0, unit='s', doc='Seconds without a shot that restart the pattern.')`

### `ViewmodelItem`

```python
@component("viewmodel_item")
class ViewmodelItem(EngineComponent)
```

On a held item's prefab: how it sits and handles in first person. Socket names are its
Model's (e.g. a model's grips, sight and muzzle).

**Fields**

- `hip: Vec3 = field(Vec3(0.14, -0.3, 0.4), unit='m', doc="Where the item's origin sits at the hip.")`
- `hip_turn: Vec3 = field(Vec3(0, 0, 0), unit='deg')`
- `sight: str = field('sight', doc='The socket put on the view axis when aiming.')`
- `eye_relief: float = field(0.17, min=0, unit='m', doc='Eye to sight when aiming.')`
- `aim: Vec3 | None = field(None, unit='m', doc='The aim position when the model has no sight socket; None: the hip moved to the centre line.')`
- `grips: tuple[str, str] = field(('grip_r', 'grip_l'), doc='Sockets the right and left hand take ("": that hand hangs free).')`
- `aim_time: float = field(0.22, min=0, unit='s')`
- `sway: float = field(1, min=0, doc='Sway and bob multiplier: heavy items move less.')`
- `recoil: Recoil = field(Recoil())`

### `ViewPose`

```python
@record
class ViewPose
```

A keyframed move added on top of the other layers (eased between keys; a pose starts
and, unless it holds, ends at rest).

**Fields**

- `seconds: float = field(0.6, min=0.01, unit='s')`
- `keys: list[PoseKey] = field([])`
- `cues: list[PoseCue] = field([], doc='Heard as ViewmodelCue when the pose passes them.')`
- `hold: bool = field(False, doc='Stay at the last key after it ends (holster) until another pose plays.')`

### `Viewmodel`

```python
@component("viewmodel")
class Viewmodel(EngineComponent)
```

**Fields**

- `item: PrefabRef | None = field(None, doc='The held item (spawned as this entity\'s child); changing it plays "draw".')`
- `arms: PrefabRef | None = field(None, doc='The arms model: an Animator whose left_hand / right_hand limbs reach the grips. None: the procedural arms.')`
- `arms_offset: Vec3 = field(Vec3(0, -0.05, 0), unit='m', doc="Where the arms model's origin (the shoulders) sits.")`
- `procedural_arms: bool = field(True, doc="Without `arms`, draw the engine's procedural arms (this entity gets their Model and Animator).")`
- `skin_color: Color = field(Color(0.8, 0.6, 0.48), doc="The procedural arms' skin.")`
- `sleeve_color: Color = field(Color(0.16, 0.18, 0.22), doc="The procedural arms' sleeves.")`
- `body: Entity | None = field(None, doc="The character whose motion paces it; None: the camera's follow target.")`
- `fov: float = field(54, min=10, max=120, unit='deg', doc="The viewmodel's own vertical field of view.")`
- `aim_fov: float = field(40, min=10, max=120, unit='deg')`
- `near: float = field(0.01, min=0.001, unit='m')`
- `body_options: dict[str, str] = field({}, doc='Model options the body shows in this camera\'s view only: {"owner": "first_person"} hides the head and arms an exported model marks hide-from-owner.')`
- `hide_body: bool = field(False, doc="Don't draw the body in this camera's view at all (its shadow still falls).")`
- `bob: float = field(1, min=0)`
- `sway: float = field(1, min=0)`
- `lag: float = field(1, min=0)`
- `sprint_offset: Vec3 = field(Vec3(0.04, -0.07, -0.06), unit='m')`
- `sprint_turn: Vec3 = field(Vec3(-8, -28, 14), unit='deg', doc='Pitch (+ up), yaw, roll of the sprint pose: muzzle down and across.')`
- `poses: dict[str, ViewPose] = field({}, doc='Named poses for play(); these replace the built-in draw, holster, reload, inspect, throw, swing.')`
- `aiming: float = field(0, min=0, max=1, doc='0 hip .. 1 aimed (kept by the engine).')`
- `pose: str | None = field(None, doc='The pose playing or holding (kept by the engine).')`
- `held: Entity | None  # read-only`

  The item entity spawned from `item`.

- `hands: Entity | None  # read-only`

  The arms entity spawned from `arms` (the procedural arms: this entity).

**Methods**

```python
def fire(*, strength: float = 1) -> None
```

Recoil: kick by the item's Recoil, scaled by `strength` and its pattern.

```python
def aim(on: bool) -> None
```

Ease toward the aim pose (or back) over the item's aim_time.

```python
def play(pose: str, *, seconds: float | None = None) -> None
```

Play a named pose from the start (PP3870 for an unknown name).

### `ViewmodelCue`

```python
@event("viewmodel_cue", target="entity")
class ViewmodelCue
```

A pose passed one of its cues (a throw's "release", a reload's "mag_in").

**Fields**

- `entity: Entity`
- `pose: str`
- `cue: str`
